pages.alt: A polar bear sits in a red chair.
A bear with a honey bee.
She is surrounded by watermelon slices.
The bee buzzes by her head.
She stands on a color palette.

text.en: Oh no! Where did all her colours go?
text.nl: O nee! Waar zijn al haar kleuren gebleven?
text.de: Oh nein! Wo sind all ihre Farben hin?
text.fa: وای نه! همه‌ی رنگ‌هایش کجا رفتند؟
